zones.title: Callback gate
zones.body: Not verified (no PIN yet), already logged, or not yet confirmed (state CALLBACK from the previous turn). Only Proceed delegates.

zones.title: Delegate
zones.body: The CASE case is delegated to XCCC with the callback note; callbackAt and state CALLBACK_LOGGED on the session. No DealerBook.

panels.title: AR-27 RequestCallback
panels.body: The callback is a case delegation, not a transfer: the dealer calls the customer back. Used when the caller asks for it or when the dealer cannot be booked online.
